args.name: Assess unfamiliar food through a controlled physical trial
args.function: Provide a reusable evidence-producing method to assess unfamiliar gathered foods, initially hazelnuts, without requiring consumption as the initial test. Measure nutrition or toxicity only if an actual supported physical test can establish them; otherwise report the limits and unresolved risks.
args.conditions: Lin has health 100 and energy 40 in mild conditions near the visible start-0-nuts plant, which has five hazelnuts. Personal knowledge does not establish hazelnut nutrition or toxicity. Appearance and growth observations do not establish edibility. Existing berry exposure trials model ordinary decay, not food safety testing.
args.inputs: A small gathered sample if needed, obtained through actual gathering. Specify any required equipment or reagents before execution; none is assumed owned or available.
args.costs: Method, time, energy and material costs are unknown. Specify them before execution, including learning requirements and any exposure risks.
args.effects: Enable supported physical testing and record measured properties, methods and limitations as personal evidence. If no non-consumptive test is supported, explicitly report that limitation rather than certifying safety. Requesting or learning alone must not create food, evidence of edibility, mastery, or wellbeing.

execution.progress: Setup is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect, retrieve and ending observation are atomic.

details.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
details.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.
